vik: Quick follow-up from the postmortem: we keep seeing the same recurring pattern (long requests blocking batching). Need an actionable SLO update, owners for dashboards/runbooks, and clear rollback gates.

nina: Adding context: p99 spikes correlate with request-length >1500 tokens and KV-cache miss >30%. Peak p99s were ~1.9s during the window.

carlos: I propose a short-term SLO guardrail so we don't page on short blips while we deploy batching scheduler fixes. Keep p95 tight. Draft numbers below.

srebot: Incident INC-2026-412 | Sev2 | start=2177998000 | end=2178001600 | primary=serving-runtime | link=https://redwood.internal/incidents/2026-412

maria: Draft SLO adjustment (temporary):
```
metric: inference_latency
window: 30d
targets:
  p95: <= 240ms
window: 14d
targets:
  p99: <= 1.05s  # temp, re-evaluate after batching rollout
notes: rollback to previous p99 if canary fails or error_rate rises >1.5%
```
Please add comments in PR.

eli: I'll own dashboarding and alerts. Plan: add per-route token-size histogram, per-instance queue depth, kv-cache hit ratio, and a request-duration vs token-count heatmap. Alerts: sustained p99 > 950ms for 3m -> page; queue_depth > 140 for 2m -> page; kv_cache_miss > 30% for 5m -> channel. ETA: 2026-04-09.

vik: Action items (recap):
- nina: add KV-cache instrumentation and correlate traces for large requests (due 2026-04-07)
- carlos: open SLO PR with rationale + rollback criteria (due 2026-04-06)
- eli: dashboard + alert PR (first pass due 2026-04-09)
- maria: runbook update for long-request bursts + emergency mitigations (due 2026-04-08)
- nina & eli: prototype fallback routing (compact-quant) in dev and add telemetry header `X-Redwood-Fallback` when used (due 2026-04-05)

nina: One wrinkle: fallback could change quality. We'll add sampled outputs to a private bucket and run quality checks. If quality drift > 5% (BLEU-like metric) in canary, abort.

carlos: Rollback/Canary gating proposals:
- auto-rollback if canary error_rate attributable to change > 1.5% over baseline for 10m
- abort if customer-facing 5xxs increase > 0.5% for 5m
- require perf test sim mixing 90% small + 10% large before promoting

maria: I'll update runbook with emergency knobs:
- manual throttle by token-length (soft-reject)
- enable fallback routing flag
- isolate overloaded instance pools and drain with `drain-serving` command
Will add links to playbook in the dashboard.

eli: I'll include an error-budget burn chart (14d) on the dashboard and an ownership tag for each alert. Also adding a short 'how we debug' panel that shows correlated logs and top requesting clients.

vik: Recurring cadence: create a "Long-context telemetry review" every 2 weeks until we have 30 days of stable telemetry. Also add a weekly action-tracker check for open items.

srebot: Reminder created: "Long-context telemetry review" recurring every 2 weeks starting 2026-04-07. Attendees: @eng-sre

nina: I'll add an integration test sim that injects mixed loads (params in PR). We should gate SLO PR on that test.

carlos: Opening PR now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/slo-config/pull/512 — please review rollback notes.

maria: Runbook draft: https://docs.internal/runbooks/long-context-bursts.md — comments welcome.

eli: Dashboard PR (WIP): https://github.com/redwood-inference/telemetry/pull/783 — will attach screenshots.

vik: Thanks everyone. Goal: close P0 items this sprint. If anyone needs to change owners or ETA, call it out here. :+1:
